name: Street Visual Quality in Hexi, Tianjin: Six Expert Ratings
description:
Method replication: same task, items and scale as the paper; the images are not the paper's stimuli (100 summer Baidu street views, May–September, re-fetched in Hexi District, Tianjin, one direction per sampling point). Each participant rates 20 random street views on six items from 1 (very low) to 5 (very high): overall visual quality, imageability, enclosure, human scale, transparency and complexity.

Original study: Zhao & Guo (2022), Sustainability 14(13), 8166. 10 researchers and designers with landscape and planning backgrounds agreed on scoring criteria on a trial set, then rated 2,200 Baidu street views of Hexi District (summer images, four directions per point) for visual quality and the five qualities on 1–5 scales; the labels trained models that scored 21,832 images.

Differences from the original study: (1) images are newly fetched Baidu views, not the 2,200 original images; (2) each participant rates 20 random images instead of the whole set; (3) the short definitions under each quality are ours, and there is no group calibration session; (4) three background questions were added.
author: Zhao & Guo

elements.title: I agree to take part. My answers are recorded anonymously for research.

elements.title: How well do you know Tianjin?

choices.text: I live or have lived there

elements.name: photo_set
elements.title: The 20 street images drawn for this participant, in order

elements.name: visual_quality
elements.title: Visual quality
elements.description: How pleasant the street scene looks to you overall. (Zhao & Guo 2022). One trial per street image, key = image file name.

elements.name: imageability
elements.title: Imageability
elements.description: How distinct and memorable the place is, so that it is easy to recognise and remember. (Zhao & Guo 2022). One trial per street image, key = image file name.

elements.name: enclosure
elements.title: Enclosure
elements.description: How well the street feels defined like an outdoor room by buildings, walls and trees. (Zhao & Guo 2022). One trial per street image, key = image file name.

elements.name: human_scale
elements.title: Human scale
elements.description: How well the size, texture and detail of buildings and objects match the size and pace of people on foot. (Zhao & Guo 2022). One trial per street image, key = image file name.

elements.name: transparency
elements.title: Transparency
elements.description: How much you can see or sense what lies beyond the street edge, such as windows, doors and open frontages. (Zhao & Guo 2022). One trial per street image, key = image file name.

elements.name: complexity
elements.title: Complexity
elements.description: How visually rich the place is: the variety of buildings, colours, materials, signs and activity. (Zhao & Guo 2022). One trial per street image, key = image file name.
